beats.title: Day one in the control room
beats.desc: Screens, alarms, and 'sit next to the senior'. Observational training without dynamic emergency reps.

beats.title: The annual reality
beats.desc: After a year, an operator has seen about 8 problems — 3 of them repeated. Rare upsets remain unpracticed.

beats.title: The senior is absent
beats.desc: A problem never seen before hits: leak, fire, or emergency shutdown. Hesitation turns into a plant trip.

beats.title: The compounding operational bill
beats.desc: 7 days of plant downtime, refractory thermal shock, emergency flaring emissions, and off-spec product.

steps.title: DCS-Style Console Operations

steps.title: Real-Time Fault Injection
steps.desc: The instructor triggers pre-programmed or live faults (pump trips, valve stiction, furnace tube leaks) and monitors trainee response in real time.

steps.title: Objective Scoring & Credentials
steps.desc: Every trainee action is timestamped against standard operating procedures. Receive an itemized performance breakdown and verification certificate.

demo.title: Try the console
demo.subtitle: Experience Nexiiva's dynamic model directly in your browser. Trigger an operational upset on the atmospheric column and watch the DCS alarms react.

responsibility.title: Safer, optimized plants start with high-fidelity digital twins.
responsibility.body1: Industrial plants operate on the front line of community safety and environmental protection. An unexpected shutdown or flaring incident carries profound consequences far beyond balance sheets.
responsibility.body2: Nexiiva provides a risk-free digital environment where operators can test transients safely, analyze procedural mistakes immediately, and master emergency sequences without venting a single gram of hydrocarbon or risking personnel safety.
